final_text:
Root cause: Panel title and subtitle text were styled only with `partial_border_style`, excluding the panel-level `style` and its background.

Changed both title and subtitle rendering to apply the combined `border_style`, preserving custom text styles while ensuring the panel background spans the entire border line.
